description: This file defines a class 'QuestionGeneratorNodes' that encapsulates various nodes for a medical exam question generation workflow, including context retrieval, question generation, validation, and citation addition. It interacts with external services like OpenAI, vector stores, image processing, and logging, and contains methods for caching, similarity checks, and content formatting.

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorNodes
classes.description: A class implementing nodes for a medical question generation workflow, including context retrieval, question creation, validation, and citation formatting.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the QuestionGeneratorNodes with API clients, storage, and caches.

methods.name: _get_cached_questions
methods.description: Retrieves questions for a chapter with caching to reduce disk I/O.

methods.name: _calculate_question_similarity
methods.description: Calculates similarity between two questions using SequenceMatcher.

methods.name: _extract_medical_terms
methods.description: Extracts key medical terms from text based on capitalization and length.

methods.name: _is_question_unique
methods.description: Checks if a question is unique based on text similarity and medical term overlap.

methods.name: _extract_covered_topics
methods.description: Extracts main topics from recent questions for context avoidance.

methods.name: _update_chunk_quality_scores
methods.description: Tracks quality scores for source chunks based on question confidence.

methods.name: retrieve_context
methods.description: Retrieves relevant context from vector store with smart selection based on covered topics and question diversity.

methods.name: generate_question
methods.description: Generates a new question using GPT-4, incorporating context and images, and checks for uniqueness.

methods.name: validate_accuracy
methods.description: Validates the generated question for medical accuracy and quality.

methods.name: add_citations
methods.description: Finalizes the question by adding source metadata, confidence scores, and updating quality metrics.
